title: Werkende vrouwen onderzoek 1982
authors: Kappe-De Haas, J., Nederlands instituut voor de publieke opinie en het marktonderzoek,  NIPO * Amsterdam (primary investigator)
descriptions: To collect information about family life and occupation of working women. Data on occupation of working women / attitude of husband towards r's job / allocation of domestic tasks / care for children / man, woman relation concerning aspects of work / media consumption. Background variables: basic characteristics/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
